io.milvus.v2.client

Class MilvusClientV2Session

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.client.MilvusClientV2Session

  • public class MilvusClientV2Session
extends Object
    A session scoped to a specific cluster of a global cluster deployment.

    All DML and DQL operations issued through a session are routed to the bound cluster. The session becomes unusable once close() is called.
